hero.title: Encrypted custody designed for cross-border capital.

stats.mainnetDetail: Production EVM rails with XRPL network controls for multi-ledger operations.

vaultIntel.label: Vault Intelligence
vaultIntel.title: Stay synced with live wallet context.

vaultIntel.statusDetail: WalletConnect, injected, and custom flows remain available.

createWallet.title: Spin up a fresh vault
createWallet.body: Generate a wallet locally, verify recovery words, and save an encrypted keystore file.
createWallet.passwordPlaceholder: Create a passphrase you will remember
createWallet.mnemonicToggleHint: Enable an extra secret (25th word) to create a hidden vault.
createWallet.mnemonicPassphraseHint: Hidden vault passphrase is never sent to the server. Losing it makes funds unrecoverable.
createWallet.passphraseTooWeak: Passphrase is too weak. Use 16+ chars with upper/lowercase, number, special, and no predictable patterns.
createWallet.verifyPrompt: Write down your mnemonic phrase and complete recovery checks before finishing.
createWallet.flowHint: Step 1 generates your 24-word recovery phrase. Step 2 verifies backup words and finalizes the wallet.
createWallet.emptyBody: Use a memorable phrase. It encrypts your local session copy.
createWallet.passphraseOfferBody: Passphrase is hidden for security. Copy it and store it offline.
createWallet.passphraseNoCopy: Copy is disabled for safety. Write your passphrase down manually.
createWallet.mnemonicHint: Store this phrase offline. Anyone with it (plus optional hidden vault passphrase) can control the wallet.
createWallet.copyDisabledNotice: Copy is disabled for sensitive secrets. Write it down manually.
createWallet.recoveryAckBackedUp: I saved the recovery phrase in a secure offline location.
createWallet.recoveryAckLoss: I understand this app cannot recover funds if the recovery phrase or hidden vault passphrase is lost.
createWallet.recoveryWordsMismatch: Recovery words do not match. Check each requested word and try again.
createWallet.recoveryAckRequired: Confirm both recovery warnings before finalizing the wallet.
createWallet.readyBody: Wallet material was generated locally in this browser. Keep your backups offline.
createWallet.buyWithCardDisabled: Using a default card provider. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_ONRAMP_URL_TEMPLATE to use your own checkout URL.
createWallet.receiveCryptoBody: Send ETH, USDC, EURC, or other supported EVM assets to this address.
createWallet.offlineReceiveNote: Funds can arrive while this app is offline. Sync balance after reconnect.
createWallet.sessionOnlyMode: Session-only mode active. No server custody key was created.
createWallet.localOnlyNotice: Non-custodial mode: keys stayed in your browser. Store your recovery phrase and keystore offline.

laws.title: Local Regulations
laws.disclaimer: Informational only, not legal advice. Confirm current obligations with local counsel.

uae.label: UAE - Dubai
uae.item1: Virtual asset activities may require VARA licensing in Dubai.
uae.item2: Customer due diligence and AML controls are typically required for custodial flows.
uae.item3: Marketing and token promotion can require pre-approval in regulated cases.

israel.label: Israel
israel.item1: Virtual asset services can trigger registration or licensing duties with local authorities.
israel.item2: AML and record-keeping controls apply where financial services are offered.
israel.item3: Consumer disclosures should clearly describe risks and custody boundaries.

eu.label: European Union
eu.item1: MiCA rules may apply to crypto-asset services and public offerings.
eu.item2: GDPR obligations apply when processing personal data and location signals.
eu.item3: Travel Rule and AML package requirements can apply to transfers and custodial services.

us.label: United States
us.item1: State-level money transmission rules may apply depending on custody and transfer activity.
us.item2: Federal AML/BSA obligations can apply to virtual asset service operators.
us.item3: Token marketing and listings may trigger securities-law analysis.

global.label: Multi-jurisdiction
global.item1: Check local virtual asset licensing rules before offering services.
global.item2: Implement AML/KYC controls aligned with the operating jurisdiction.
global.item3: Document user disclosures, risk notices, and data-handling practices.
